source.description: A mangy hunched vulture with a bald pink neck and ragged dark-brown feathers, shifting its weight from foot to foot, head twitching as it looks around, feathers ruffling slightly. Seamless loop.

The ragged brown vulture with a bald pink neck attacks — it spreads its tattered wings wide, lunges its hooked beak toward the camera with a sharp pecking strike, then folds back into its hunched stance.

_notes: 1-direction object, side-scroller view. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
